predecessors.name: Fourteenth Dynasty of Egypt
predecessors.text: 'conquered Lower Egypt'; the Hyksos takeover 'put an end to the Fourteenth Dynasty of Egypt'

predecessors.name: Middle Kingdom of Egypt
predecessors.text: Memphis, which 'the Fifteenth Dynasty expanded to occupy'

successors.name: New Kingdom of Egypt
successors.text: the Hyksos Delta and Middle Egypt, taken by Ahmose I after the conquest of Avaris

ledger.x: c. 1650: Salitis founds the Hyksos Fifteenth Dynasty at Avaris. 'It was founded by Salitis, a Hyksos from West Asia'; infobox 'Established: 1650 BC' and 'Capital: Avaris'; Hyksos 'conquered Lower Egypt'.

c. 1650: the Hyksos take Memphis. 'The Fifteenth Dynasty expanded to occupy Memphis.' The page gives no year; bridged to the foundation. wars.name: Hyksos-Theban conflict under the Sixteenth Dynasty
wars.outcome: Unresolved on the pages: 'The armies of the 15th Dynasty, winning town after town ... eventually threatening and then conquering Thebes itself'; the dynasty ends c.

wars.name: Ahmose I's reconquest of Egypt from the Hyksos
wars.outcome: Theban victory: Avaris falls (the fourth attack) and the Hyksos are followed to Sharuhen near Gaza, besieged three years.

certainty.note: Hyksos frontiers are known only by the places campaigns reached (Memphis, Cusae, Thebes): approximate throughout.
